Perform 5 sets of 3 jump pull-ups, resting 1 minute between sets. 

Start each rep standing on the floor holding onto the bar or rings. Your arms should have a slight bend in them still even with your legs slightly bent. Jump off the ground and pull upwards as fast and explosively as possible. 

Aim to get your chin clear over the bar and then lower down at a slower pace keeping your hands on the bar at all times. Once you touch the floor with your feet jump and pull back up explosively to max height once more. 

Do not add weight to your body during this workout.  Due to the amount of lateral force generated in the pulling motion, this workout should only be performed on a floor-mounted pull-up bar.
